task.title: Repair and verify Rosco portability lockfile consistency
task.scope: Resolve root lockfile consistency and verify a fresh temporary clean copy without modifying application, contract, worker, Rosco-loop, or deployment code.

approval: Josh explicitly authorized npm registry access for root lockfile consistency and requested temporary clean-copy npm ci followed by rosco:verify. No commit or loop promotion was authorized.
intent: Make the repository-relative DreamLoops runtime dependency installable from a clean copy and preserve Rosco's manual draft boundary.

evidence: npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund completed under Node v24.13.0 / npm 11.6.2.

The final root package-lock.json removes the stale ../../everythingDreamNet/dreamloops/packages/runtime entry, retains vendor/dreamloops-runtime, and records optional bufferutil@4.0.9 with its node-gyp-build dependency. The bufferutil lock record was added after npm install did not add the missing optional peer.
A fresh temporary clone received the current package.json, package-lock.json, Rosco files, and verifier; no existing node_modules were copied.
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund passed in the temporary copy using Node v24.13.0 / npm 11.6.2: added 758 packages in 4m.
npm run rosco:verify passed all six acceptance checks in that temporary copy.
Fresh temporary clean-copy npm ci completed with exit code 0.

Rosco verifier completed with exit code 0: Capsule validation, DreamLoop validation, successful local session-start execution, receipt-schema validation, Markdown-link validation, and no-external-action boundary all passed.
The loop status remains draft; no promotion was performed.
npm retrieved registry package data and installed dependencies locally in the authorized root and temporary copy.
No deployment, wallet, contract, production mutation, external communication, or unattended schedule occurred.
Temporary verification copies were removed after completion.
